 'The Five' co-hosts discuss the WNBA's decision to declare former NBA players Enes Kanter Freedom and Royce White ineligible to play in the league. 
 Former NBA players Enes Kanter Freedom and Royce White are blocked from the WNBA draft, sparking conversation on 'The Five.' The co-hosts analyze the league's official statement that only women are eligible to play. Freedom questions who has the authority to determine eligibility.
